description: Pixel age from Present() submission to usable detections (boxes, classes, scores after NMS) from YOLO11n on the RTX 4060 via ONNX Runtime 1.30 CUDA, with the build/scenes/default scene panning under the frame-ID marker. Medians across 3 passes of 8 s per path; every path verified first. Processes pinned to logical processors 2-15 (mask 0xfffc), a different CPU configuration from the 0xffff ingestion runs, so not pooled with them.
machine: Machine B, MUX discrete-only: RTX 4060 Laptop drives the display and does the CUDA work, 2560x1600 at 165 Hz
